data.notes: December 2026 is still early for Miami club and Art Week party announcements, so the confirmed calendar is currently weighted toward arena concerts and holiday programming.

events.title: The R&B Tour - Starring Usher Raymond & Chris Brown
events.summary: Usher and Chris Brown bring their co-headlining R&B stadium tour to Hard Rock Stadium in Miami Gardens. The Live Nation listing confirms the Thursday, December 3, 2026 show at 7:00 PM.

events.title: The R&B Tour - Starring Usher Raymond & Chris Brown
events.summary: A second Miami-area stadium date for Usher and Chris Brown’s co-headlining R&B tour is confirmed at Hard Rock Stadium. The Live Nation listing confirms the Saturday, December 5, 2026 show at 7:00 PM.

events.title: RAWAYANA - ¿Dónde Es El After? World Tour
events.summary: Venezuelan band Rawayana brings the ¿Dónde Es El After? World Tour to Kaseya Center for two confirmed nights. The venue lists shows on December 5 and December 6, 2026, both at 8:00 PM.

events.title: Candlelight: Christmas Classics
events.summary: Fever’s Candlelight series presents a holiday string-quartet program at Eden Roc Miami Beach. The tourism listing confirms the Saturday, December 19, 2026 performance at 4:00 PM, with Collins Quartet noted as performer.
